card.title: 28cm COASTAL HOWITZER
card.flavorText: The 28 cm howitzer L/10 was a Japanese coastal and siege howitzer. It was developed by the British manufacturing company called Armstrong before 1892 and saw service in the Russo-Japanese War during the siege of Port Arthur and the Second Sino-Japanese War. Due to a lack of other alternatives the Japanese reactivated the 28 cm howitzer for coastal defense in 1945, and it was used with some success during the Soviet invasion of Manchuria in 1945.
